title: odostemon angustifolius
intro: Odostemon angustifolius, commonly known as Mountain Pennyroyal, is a perennial plant native to North America, characterized by its small, rounded leaves and delicate purple flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and reduce anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Pennyroyal include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Odostemon angustifolius include essential oils, such as thujone and pinene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
